ayahs.1: By the night when it covers—
ayahs.2: By the day when it shines—
ayahs.3: By the One who created male and female—
ayahs.4: Your strivings are indeed diverse—people chase different ends.
ayahs.5: As for the one who gives and guards with taqwa—living with Allah-consciousness, as though Allah sees you—
ayahs.6: And believes in the finest reward—
ayahs.7: We will ease for him the path of ease—toward deeds that lead to relief in the Akhirah.
ayahs.8: And as for the stingy one who deems himself self-sufficient—
ayahs.10: We will ease for him the path of hardship—choices that harden into difficulty.
ayahs.11: His wealth will not help when he falls headlong—into ruin in the grave and on the Day of Judgment.
ayahs.12: Guidance is truly upon Us to give—
ayahs.13: And to Us belong this dunya—the temporary worldly life—and the Akhirah, the everlasting life after death.
ayahs.14: And so I have warned you of a raging Fire—
ayahs.15: None will burn in it except the most wretched—
ayahs.17: But the most mindful of taqwa will be kept far from it—
ayahs.18: The one who gives his wealth to purify himself—
ayahs.19: Not repaying a favour owed to anyone,
ayahs.20: But seeking only the Face of his Lord, the Most High.
ayahs.21: And soon he will be well pleased.
